title: From first visit to first inquiry
summary: A considered business website, connected to an inquiry flow that keeps the conversation moving behind the scenes.
challenge: A business has a clear service but a fragmented online journey. Visitors struggle to find the right information, and website inquiries arrive without enough context for the team to act.
approach: Structure the site around real customer questions, build accessible pages for every screen, and connect a focused inquiry form to a shared customer record and follow-up task.
outcome: The intended experience joins a clear customer journey to an organised internal handoff. This example explores the design and workflow; it is not a delivered client project.
